privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how the Platform collects, uses, retains, and protects your personal information. This policy complies with applicable data protection regulations including GDPR, PIPL, and CCPA (see ADR-023 Data Privacy Classification and Right to Deletion).

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
body: The Platform follows the principle of data minimization, collecting only the personal information necessary to provide its services: username (hashed), email address, and organization name.
The Platform does not collect unnecessary personally identifiable information (PII). Passwords are stored in hashed form, and the Platform cannot access your plaintext password.
For security and audit purposes, the Platform records login events, operation logs, and usage events. See the data classification document and PII field registry for details.

dataUse.title: Data Use
body: Your personal information is used only for: providing backtesting and analysis services, authentication and session management, organization member management, billing and quota control, security audit and compliance requirements.
The Platform does not sell your personal information to third parties. Without your explicit consent, your data will not be used for marketing purposes.

Some service features may require data transmission to third-party service providers (e.g., data source APIs). The Platform ensures such transmissions follow the minimization principle and are contractually bound.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention & Deletion
body: The Platform follows a clear data retention and archival strategy: backtest results are retained for 90 days (hot storage) to 3 years (deleted after archival); audit logs are retained for 7 years (compliance requirement); usage events are retained for 13 months before being aggregated into statistics.

Under GDPR Article 17 (Right to be Forgotten), you have the right to request deletion of your personal data. The Platform provides a three-tier deletion mechanism: deactivation (soft delete, reversible), anonymization (default recommended, erases identifiers but retains audit records), and hard deletion (complete deletion).

Please note: for compliance obligations, audit logs are not deleted during the retention period; only user identifiers are anonymized. To exercise your right to deletion, please use account settings or contact our support team.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
body: The Platform uses an httpOnly cookie to store the refresh token, ensuring session security. This cookie is not accessible via JavaScript, effectively preventing cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.
The Platform does not use third-party tracking cookies or advertising cookies. Only essential session cookies are used to maintain login state.
You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings, but disabling cookies may cause login functionality to not work properly.

disclaimer.intro: This risk disclosure statement is intended to help you understand the inherent risks and limitations of using the Platform for backtesting analysis. Please read the following carefully before making any investment decisions.

riskDisclosure.title: Risk Disclosure
body: All content provided by the Platform is for research and educational purposes only and does not constitute investment advice, securities recommendations, or trading instructions.
Backtest results are simulated based on historical data and do not represent actual trading results. Historical performance does not predict future results, and investing may result in capital loss.
You should fully understand investment risks, consult a licensed financial advisor when necessary, and invest only money you can afford to lose.

survivorshipBias.title: Survivorship Bias
body: The Platform's historical data may contain survivorship bias: delisted, merged, or bankrupt tickers may not be in the current dataset, causing backtest results to be systematically overstated.

To mitigate survivorship bias, the Platform makes every effort to include delisted tickers in data acquisition. For data processing methodology and known limitations, please refer to the methodology documentation.
You should consider the potential impact of survivorship bias when interpreting backtest results and avoid overly optimistic expectations of returns.

backtestLimitations.title: Backtest Limitations
body: Backtesting cannot replicate all factors in actual trading, including but not limited to: market impact costs, slippage, liquidity constraints, trading latency, partial fills, and emotional factors.
The Platform's backtesting engine uses simplified transaction cost assumptions (e.g., fixed rates) in calculations, which may differ from actual trading costs.

Overfitting is a common risk in strategy backtesting: strategies that perform well on historical data may not remain effective in the future. It is recommended to use out-of-sample data validation and Monte Carlo simulation to assess strategy robustness.

dataSource.title: Data Source Disclaimer
body: The Platform's historical market data is sourced from third-party data providers (including yfinance, finnhub, akshare, BaoStock, etc.). The Platform makes no express or implied warranty regarding the completeness, accuracy, timeliness, or reliability of the data.

Third-party data may contain errors, omissions, or delays. Changes in data source service availability, API changes, or data format adjustments may affect the Platform's data acquisition capabilities.
You should independently verify key data when using the Platform. The Platform is not liable for any losses arising from reliance on the data.
